fields.name: start_time
fields.label: %start_time%
fields.help: HH:MM on the wall clock of the place.

fields.name: end_time
fields.label: %end_time%
fields.help: HH:MM; earlier than the start means it ends the next day.

fields.name: early_window_min
fields.label: %early_window_min%
fields.help: A punch this long before the start still belongs to the shift.

fields.name: late_window_min
fields.label: %late_window_min%
fields.help: A punch this long after the end still belongs to the shift.

fields.name: break_min
fields.label: %break_min%
fields.help: The usual unpaid break, deducted when none is recorded.

fields.name: half_day_below_min
fields.label: %half_day_below_min%
fields.help: Worked minutes below this count as half a day; 0: not used.

fields.name: absent_below_min
fields.label: %absent_below_min%
fields.help: Worked minutes below this count as absent; 0: not used.
